Transfer retention is not established; the key moved outside the closed receiving tips. Separate open hands slightly to observe and recover safely.

Lower the open left gripper above the fallen key while restoring the shaft-aligned pickup yaw.
Complete the downward approach to the relocated key, leaving final centering to the next wrist observation.

Raise the recovered key and inspect its stability before attempting a more carefully aligned handover.

Reacquire the settled key, aiming for the shaft immediately above the bow rather than its teeth.
Align the now-settled key's shaft and lower to pickup height; inspect before closing.
Refine shaft centering from the wrist image, placing the grasp just above the bow and matching its angle.

Continue the stable lift and presentation; keep receiving fingers open until the bow is aligned.
Continue rotating the securely held key toward the right hand, keeping the bow clear of the receiving fingers.

Bring the open right gripper above the fallen key and continue matching the shaft orientation.
Finish the downward-facing recovery orientation and descend above the key, keeping clear of the lock.
